annotations.title: Look up an AI Act article

description: Look up a reference to Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (e.g. "Art. 53(1)(d)", "Annex III", "Recital 60") and return related events plus the EUR-Lex URL. Matches whole references: "Art. 5" finds Art. 5 and Art. 5(1)(b), never Art. 50. References the Regulation does not have (Art. 1 to 113, Annex I to XIII, Recital 1 to 180) return known: false and no EUR-Lex link.
name: lookup_article
